Ordinary/scenario wrappers never admit zero based only on client source ID.
EndedAt and canonical completion mode participate in existing final admission fingerprints and lightweight clones.
Required runtime feature snapshots retain full deterministic feature contract while dropping executable DSL; real attached scripts recompute.
Actual compiler/reopen and final reference-allocation barrier tests check refusal/no copy/source preservation.
Durable duration spelling/default mode normalization is compared semantically, with exact empty iteration duration retained.
limits: Focused review of the incremental backend admission/compatibility correction; broader frontend/source review and real current execution gates have separately retained receipts. No full program completion or target execution claim.
